course.title: Computer Integrated Manufacturing
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A 22- station in-line transfer machine has an ideal cycle time of 0.35 min. Station break-downs occur with a probability p=0.01. Assume that station breakdowns are the only reason for line stops. Average downtime=8.0 min per line stop. Use the upper-bound approach to determine i) Ideal production rate R<sub>c</sub> ii) Frequency of line stops F iii) Average actual production rate $\mathrm { R } _ { \mathrm { p } }$ and iv) line efficiency E.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
